note: Caretaker generator. Founders' callsigns are retired; everyone else is stamped from ~60 donor templates, so donors repeat across Mars (the Echo).

callsign.unit_number: 001-999, unique per pioneer region; numbers repeat across regions (the Echo)
callsign.retired_note: Founders' and Second Ring callsigns are retired in P1's region only. Other pioneers' regions have their own ANVIL, CADENCE, FURROW and so on (the Echo).

bark_rules: Barks from templates are runtime lines: generated per unit with its template voice plus per-unit variation (pitch +-1 st, rate +-5%, accent strength). They are not in lines.json.
act3_wrong barks only from Act III; act4_knowing only after 4.3 (SUTURE's confession spreads); named only after 4.4 and only if the player uses the name.
Each unit holds 2-3 drift traits; barks with a bark_hint should be weighted toward that trait.
No generated unit ever uses a founder's or Second Ring unit's authored line, EXCEPT the Echo lines below, which are intentionally identical.

act5_named_last replaces act5_warned/act5_unwarned as a generated unit's last words if the player addressed it by its real name before its Recall; that unit's name then goes on the Rest plaque or the Fugitive hideout wall.

echo.note: The tractor story, word for word, same audio file as FURROW.

Keeps dead beds wet for a pioneer who died 30 years ago.
Lays the same cable to the same ridge, forever.

echo.unit_example: any unit from T54 in any city
echo.note: A Galway publican's memory: the only other Galway voice the player meets. Rowan drank in her bar once. She doesn't remember him; nobody in Galway would.

systems.stewards: Each founder runs a settlement and shapes its growth priorities while the player sleeps.
systems.trust: How the player treats a settlement changes its output and, in Act V, how its caretakers meet the Recall (resist / surrender / inform). None survive.
systems.names: After 4.4 any caretaker's donor name can be recovered (open_unit_file). Names are a collectible; using them changes the endings.
systems.loss: Storms, accidents and the Recall destroy units. Generated units can be replaced; founders cannot.
